text: Track 2.1 Good morning. Today I'm going to talk to you about the option of using our oceans to provide us with the energy we need for the future. For a long time, we've used the ocean for two things – travel and food. But now, people are thinking of using the ocean to provide another resource – energy. This makes a lot of sense because oceans cover 70% of the earth. Oceans can give us clean energy forever, not like fossil fuels which are limited and will soon run out. Could this be a solution to the climate crisis? We'll have to wait and see. Now, how do we get energy from the ocean? Firstly, we can use waves which are the rise and fall of the ocean to run a generator. That's a machine that makes electricity. As the wave moves, it makes energy. The bigger the wave, the more energy it has. We can also use energy from waves to make air go through another type of machine – a turbine – to make electricity too. But some people correctly say that waves are not a good alternative energy source because they aren't always the same size and they travel at different speeds. Also, we can only use some areas of the ocean because most areas don't get big waves – not big enough to produce the energy people need anyway. However, we can also use tides. Tides are when the ocean moves towards and away from the land, caused by the pull of the moon and the sun, and they are another source of energy. We can make electricity from their movement by using power plants called barrages. Barrages are like big walls built across rivers where they join the sea. The barrage catches water at high tide and then lets it out at low tide through turbines to make electricity. One of the benefits of using tides is that we know when they are going to happen, which is twice a day. Yet we can't predict how they will move and barrages are only useful in places where there is a big difference between high and low tides. Very few places have this big difference, which means that energy production is not reliable. Barrages also cause environmental issues. They can damage wildlife in the area like birds. They are also not very nice to look at and are not a benefit to people who live far from the ocean. To sum up, the ocean's mechanical energy, which is how the water in the ocean moves, can provide a lot of power. In fact, scientists believe that the world's waves and tides can make twice the amount of energy we produce now. However, using the ocean's mechanical energy also has a lot of disadvantages. It is expensive, not very efficient, and it can cause environmental problems.
